{"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of nuclear/security staffing, regulatory independence, IAEA-related institutional choices, and counterevidence involving loyalists or ideologues.
I did not find a public 2024 example of Sisi appointing a clearly independent nuclear-security technocrat to override loyalist control, nor a case where a security agency was publicly depoliticized.
The strongest positive items are institutional rhetoric and international regulatory alignment, not a documented internal personnel reform in the nuclear chain of command.
The strongest negative items are the July 2024 defense/intelligence reshuffles, which show that Sisi still relied on a trusted inner circle for core security posts.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi Meets Prime Minister and Members of the New Government","publisher":"","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-el-sisi-meets-prime-minister-and-members-of-the-new-government/","summary":"Sisi told the new government to strengthen institutional frameworks and governance, improve coordination across ministries and state agencies, and emphasize integrity, transparency, and effective communication.
